## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## API, SDK and MCP impact

Describe contract, SDK and MCP updates, or explain why external behavior is unchanged. Link any intentional transport exclusion and its reason.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. Include screenshots for meaningful UI changes.

## Rollout

Note compatibility changes, migrations or operational steps. Leave empty if none.

Confirm that logs, screenshots and fixtures contain no credentials, authentication links or personal email data.
